name: Telluride
summary: A jewel-box former mining town at the head of a stunning box canyon — a free gondola, a towering waterfall, and famous festivals.

lodging.name: A Telluride or Mountain Village lodge
lodging.blurb: In the box canyon or up the gondola.

foodMustTry.name: Après fare in the box canyon

item.title: Main Street & Bridal Veil Falls
item.blurb: A box canyon with one way in, a main street of false-front Victorians below it, and Colorado's tallest free-falling waterfall at the closed end — Butch Cassidy robbed his first bank here, and the town looks much as it did when he did.

item.title: The gondola to Mountain Village

location.name: Telluride Gondola
location.address: Oak St & San Juan Ave, Telluride, CO

item.blurb: Free, thirteen minutes over a 10,500-ft ridge to Mountain Village, and the only transit system of its kind in the country — built as a condition of the resort's expansion so the two halves of town wouldn't need a road between them. Telluride's ski runs fall away on both sides; See Forever, the run down the ridgeline, is named for exactly what you get from the top.
